$comment: Shared LTV test vectors. PLATFORM.md section 4 requires the on-chain program,
the watcher, the web app and the bot to agree on these numbers.
Only `ltvBps` is asserted exactly: it is an integer and it is the value every
threshold comparison runs on. The float fields are display values and are
asserted within a tolerance, because IEEE 754 division does not reproduce
bit-for-bit across Rust and JavaScript and pretending otherwise would make
this file fail for the wrong reason.
Adding a case here is how the contract gets extended. Any implementation that
cannot reproduce a case is wrong, including this one.

cases.name: healthy position, half the collateral borrowed
same position after a 30 percent drop, repeating decimal rounds up
exact half basis point rounds away from zero, not to even
no debt is never liquidated at any price
already past the liquidation threshold, no room left to fall
debt with no collateral reads as maximum unhealthy, not as infinity
underwater position reports a ratio above 100 percent rather than clamping

actionCases.name: bring a 71.43 percent position back to 60 percent
a position already below target needs no action
repayment is capped at the outstanding debt
